# Farming Guide: Corrosive Stingwings

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 21, 2025
- 2 min read

__Used for:__

**SCORE**

**Daily**

- Kill a Corrosive Stingwing (5)
- EPIC - Kill a Corrosive Stingwing (12)

**Weekly**

- Kill a Corrosive Stingwing (25)
- EPIC - Kill a Corrosive Stingwing (35)

**Lifetime Challenge**

- Kill a Corrosive Stingwing (5)
- Kill a Corrosive Stingwing (15)
- Kill a Corrosive Stingwing (30)
- Kill a Corrosive Stingwing (76)
- Kill a Corrosive Stingwing (250)

**Mini Season**

- Kill an Insect with a Pistol and the Sunset Sarsaparilla Deputy Hat Equipped (25)
- Kill an Enemy in the Burning Springs Region with a Pistol and the Sunset Sarsaparilla Deputy Hat Equipped (35)
- Kill a Corrosive Stingwing with the Sunset Sarsaparilla Deputy Hat Equipped (30)
- Kill an Enemy in the Burning Springs Region with a Pistol and the Sunset Sarsaparilla Deputy Hat Equipped (175)

**Events**

Sinkhole Solutions

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ab2eb487b65549c9bd1cc101d1366ea2~mv2.jpg)

**Random Encounters**

Burning Springs only

- Stingwings vs Deathclaw
- Stingwing vs Radscorpions
- Stingwing vs Rust King Raiders

**Fixed Spawns**

**Hocking Hills Train Station**

2 Spawns

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d5db201b269349959446a2064792183d~mv2.jpg)

From the spawn in location, face south and follow the road around. You will come to a ute or pickup truck with Abraxo barrels in the tray on your right. The stingwings are located between the ute and the train tracks in front of you.

**Abraxodyne Chemical Power Substation**

4 spawns

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_eecfdce5b2734cdea30b9d8dbed4bd49~mv2.jpg)

From the spawn in location, face north and follow the road past the Rust Raider checkpoint. Keep running until you reach the road on your right, just before the food truck in the car park. Turn right and continue along the road until you see the large bucket on your left. The stingwings can spawn in the middle of the road, in the car park on your right, or inside the large bucket on your left.
